note: Without the RTX PRO 6000, every layer alike, closeness before speed: resident rows on every rank, the misses of ranks 0-3 that have a 2-bit record in CPU memory staged in every layer, the mean substitute for the rest; no band. The staging time per call is bounded by K31_STAGE_CAP (records per decode call, largest routing weight first) and K31_STAGE_ROWS (staged ranks per row of a verify block), which the quality-nortx profile sets.
